title: Rationality of the Canonical Unramified Arthur Filtration
main_claim: Assume the four characteristic hypotheses (those of AGKRRV §14.4.1 and §D.1.1). Then for split connected semisimple G over a function field, every closed invariant Y in the dual nilpotent cone, and every l ≠ p, the canonical Arthur filtration F_Y A_E (the image of H^0 Tr(Φ, C_Y) in the finitely supported functions) is defined over Q: E ⊗ (A_Q ∩ F_Y A_E) → F_Y A_E is an isomorphism. The proof goes through a bilinear Hecke-moment measure detector. For every f, g there is a unique measure ν_{f,g} on B = ∪_o B_o with [T_D f, g] = ∫ χ_D dν_{f,g}, and f ∈ F_Y exactly when supp ν_{f,g} ⊂ B_Y for every g. Since this criterion uses only rational data, the filtration is Aut(E/Q)-invariant, and Galois descent finishes the proof.

issues.description: The contraction lemma needs the weight-zero morphism cohomology to sit in true cohomological degree 0. Prop. orb:hom-calculation proves this in the lifted degree (the grading twisted by λ_e). The paper only checks parity: λ(-1) is central in L_e, so after taking invariants the super-intertwiners are even. It does not spell out the matching of the full Z-grading on the coefficient Hom at e. This is plausible, since P sits in lifted degree 0 and the combined grading/λ action fixes the fiber at e. It is just not argued in detail.
issues.evidence: Sec 4 says 'the lifted total-degree sign computes true alternating traces after taking invariants'. Lemma tr:bar-contraction separately requires 'weight-zero morphism cohomology concentrated in degree zero'.

coverage: I read every section closely. Section 7 (descent), checked: the B_o are compact and pairwise disjoint (the positive part λ_e(√r) determines λ_e; JM open orbit in ĝ_2). The character algebra is closed under conjugation via the SL2 Weyl element, giving conj χ_D(as) = χ_{D^∨}(as). The central z^d and λ_e(-1) lie in the compact triple centralizer. Changing the sign of √q gives the factor (-1)^{d⟨2ρ,μ⟩}, which matches z^d. Row-echelon descent is correct, and the fixed field of Aut(E/Q) is Q. Section 6 (detector), checked: existence and uniqueness of the measures. Forward direction: common-support bound. Converse: minimal filtration index, top-orbit density p_e is nowhere zero (all weights strictly negative), 1/p_e is approximated by twisted characters, and Schur on the semisimple Clifford category gives c_Q = 0. Boundary contributions are separated because the ad-rank strictly drops (J-stable complement plus lower semicontinuity of rank). Incomparable orbits and permuted strata are handled. Section 5, checked: the paracyclic homotopy and its inverse (1-S), contraction of negative-weight blocks, the Koszul invariant-base factor det(1-F_U) ≠ 0, and the localization short exact sequences giving injectivity. Section 4, checked: the weight table is internally consistent (x-coordinates -1-i, normal tangents -2+i, Lie(U_e)^* -i, e fixed after translation, W of weight 0). Also checked: ker e lies in V_{≥0}, the Clifford supercommutator Koszul argument, and the JM incidence properness. Section 3, checked: nonresonance moduli q^{-(n-1)/2} at order n (only the quadratic differential survives), the finite-covariants and Krull argument, BCH giving the obstruction ½[x,x], and the compact normalization and cyclic frame value λ_e(q^{d/2})s. Taken on trust: the GR restricted equivalence and Frobenius convention; AGKRRV trace/local-term comparison and nonstandard duality with compactness; Toda/PT Koszul equivalence and the support correspondence; the GLR appendix semisimple pure-lift statement; the HSS trace localization; and the AGKRRV formal-affine presentation inputs.
sibling_notes: Family 014 siblings (RGL in positive characteristic, Ramanujan-Arthur decompositions, Global Arthur enhancements, tempered ramified, tame eigensheaves) all reported no_gap_found. This paper cites RGLCompanion only for the remark that Z is the full restricted stack, and does not use it: the whole argument works with the prime union Z. CuspidalArthur Thm 1.1 / Lemmas 6.1–6.2 / Props 6.5–6.6 are used only in Cor. desc:cuspidal-comparison, not in the main theorem.
